proof_attempt_summary: The D-stage derivation established the product identity, conditional shifted cube-root laws, two counterexample families, and a certified interval on a restricted subclass. The math review passed, but the field-tier referee graded the delivered package subfield with a 7.1 ceiling below 7.4; resolving the bare endpoint rates and broadening the inference theorem would require new research. The remaining Wang2026/Sun2026 related-work comparison needs positioning or removal before reuse.
tldr: Global orthogonality is not local robustness for a learned threshold, and local robustness is not global localization. The atom-compatible transported-survival score has an exact transport/outcome plus censor-hazard/outcome product bias with distinct pre- and post-jump denominators and a version-invariant zero extension on null event tails. Conditional on global localization, strip-local score transfer yields the two-source Gaussian cube-root law and bounded critical profiles yield the integrated drift \(D_\beta\). A coherent normalized transport/outcome family, now certified by explicit positive strip mass, conditional variance, boundary noise, and optimizer displacement, refutes every polynomial exponent above one quarter and every logarithmically strengthened quarter rate while leaving the coherent bare little-\(o\) quarter endpoint open. Separately, Zhao--Josse--Yang Assumption 6 controls the hazard-over-censor-survival nuisance \(\widehat\lambda_C/\widehat S_C-\lambda_C/S_C\), not a ratio to the true hazard and not a common fitted-law product integral. The independently parameterized censor witness satisfies that exact norm and yields the one-sixth frontier; it is explicitly incoherent. The certified compact-subclass interval retains uniformly honest \(N^{-1/3}\) width, and the ICU application remains only a prospective lower-dimensional consumer.
gap: Zhao--Josse--Yang establish a cube-root rate for a transported censored-survival rule under global nuisance \(L_2\) rates, but their proof controls the fitted criterion at fixed policies before using a shrinking-boundary modulus. Cheng--Yang derive a policy-index limit without transport or censoring, and Seo--Otsu leave the application-specific local nuisance drift to the user.
fill: The project fixes the randomized-trial score with protocol-known assignment probabilities, fixes a measurable zero extension for null event tails, derives the tie-safe product identity, proves the two-source strip limit and fitted-score transfer, places deterministic critical drift in a bounded profile class that implies coercivity and unique finite argmax, gives a coherent estimator-level displacement counterexample, and supplies a total interval whose radius is the minimum integer satisfying a fully displayed certified uniform-coverage event on the externally calibrated regular subclass.
